run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare wiki file branching
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy files with a version prefix via SVN
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update links in branched wiki files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to rewrite internal wiki references
drop_DropWikiSuffix: drop the .wiki suffix from a filename using DropWikiSuffix to get the base page name
